tagline: An inhaled, protein-based mRNA carrier that makes airway cells produce their own asthma medicine.
summary: PARCEL is an inhaled mRNA delivery platform built from elastin-like polypeptides (ELPs) rather than lipid nanoparticles. The fusion protein ELP-Pum2-EEP13 uses Pum2 to grab mRNA carrying a PRS tag in its 3' UTR, ELP phase separation to encapsulate and protect it, an endosomal escape peptide to get out of the endosome, and a Sortase A-conjugated anti-UPK1B scFv to target airway club cells; the cargo is mRNA for SLPI (inhibiting neutrophil elastase and the mucus hypersecretion it triggers) plus a lower dose of IFN-lambda-1 (antiviral defence and Th2 suppression). It won 1st Runner-up and Best Integrated Human Practices because the stakeholder work genuinely steered the science: clinicians moved the project from rescue therapy to maintenance therapy, and an asthma mechanism researcher killed one of the two original cargoes outright. The dry lab is unusually complete, modelling the whole chain from E. coli production through nebulizer aerosol deposition to a PK-PD readout in FEV1 and FeNO, with every module feeding the next.

dry.frameworks: Six connected modules sharing parameters and declared input-output relationships. (1) Production: a SimBiology ODE model of a quorum-sensing kill switch (LuxI/LuxRm A1 variant, pLuxRm-driven lysis) combining growth-dependent dilution with AHL kinetics, swept across Anderson promoters to find the one that lyses the culture just before ELP phase transition - this chose the promoter the wet lab used. (2) Assembly: AlphaFold 3 predicted the three fusion-protein monomers (1052-1322 residues), coarse-grained into Martini 3 and run in GROMACS for 2-3 microseconds at 298 K, 1 bar, 150 mM NaCl, 50 mg/mL protein, with pLDDT used to justify stabilising the Pum2 fold while leaving ELP flexible; alongside this they built CAPE (Coverage and Assembly Prediction for Protein Ensembles), a reduced free-energy model calibrated against wet-lab data, and used Bayesian optimization over CAPE as the objective to redistribute ELP repeats around Pum2 instead of brute-forcing every combination. (3) Pulmonary delivery: MPPD v3.04 on the adult Yeh-Schum five-lobe geometry screened log-normal aerosol size distributions, flow rates and inhaled volumes against deposition in the last three conducting generations per lobe, then ANSYS Fluent CFD simulated 3D airway transport, feeding a distal airway and airway-surface-liquid transport model and a reference cell-composition mapping that converts deposition into surface contacts per club cell. (4) Intracellular release: a hybrid ODE-stochastic model of one particle per endosome (median 560 nm, ~2,400 fusion chains and therefore 2,400 EEP copies per particle), tracking acidification, ELP disassembly, EEP-mediated membrane opening and RNA degradation to output intact cytosolic RNA over time, with intact RNA tracked separately from fluorescent label. (5) PK-PD: a four-compartment model (bone marrow, blood, airway wall, epithelial lining fluid) with 25 species, 53 assignment rules and 51 reactions, adapted from Gadkar et al.'s severe asthma immune network, giving four clinical readouts - FeNO, FEV1, relative goblet-cell count and 15-minute mucin release - used to compare SLPI:IFN-lambda-1 payload ratios and dosing frequency. (6) Response prediction: an affine mapping baseline plus residual CellFlow (flow matching) trained on public cytokine-perturbation scRNA-seq.
dry.dataviz: The model landing page opens with a scripted animation that walks the whole mechanism in sequence - the E. coli shell fills with protein, lyses, chains assemble into PARCEL, the particle travels into the bronchi, binds a club-cell receptor, is endocytosed, disassembles, releases mRNA, and mucus drops one step per round - with replay and skip controls and a text fallback when JavaScript is off. AlphaFold monomer structures are embedded as interactive viewers with pLDDT and protein-region colouring and cartoon/C-alpha toggles, so a reader can see directly why Pum2 was treated as rigid and ELP as flexible. The wiki also carries font-size controls (A-/Default/A+) for accessibility. On the software side, the AeroEase Android app turns raw device timestamps into an expandable-card Overview with a seven-day activity chart and a date-filtered History, and the FeroEase app plots live temperature, pH and OD600 with a falling-trend detector that flags the harvest window.
dry.datascience: Two concrete pieces. The target screen: using the Human Lung Cell Atlas they compared healthy adult club cells against other lung epithelial cells on fold change, adjusted p-value and detection fraction, and from 68 genes passing the criteria selected UPK1B - 2.28-fold enriched, adjusted p = 0.00559, RNA detected in 45.92% of club cells versus 3.43% of other epithelial cells. They then checked antibody accessibility (Human Surfaceome; UniProt O75841, 260 aa, four transmembrane regions, extracellular stretches at 37-60 and 108-229) and cross-tissue selectivity (archived GTEx: 0.11 TPM lung vs 21.90 TPM bladder; Human Protein Atlas showing membranous expression in urothelium), and stated plainly that UPK1B is not club-cell exclusive so the analysis prioritises an experimental candidate rather than demonstrating selective targeting. The response-prediction benchmark is equally honest: affine mapping cut mean-expression error 7.1% against predicting no change and beat the mean-response baseline, while the nonlinear residual CellFlow model improved some mean-expression predictions but worsened distributional agreement and the selected RNA panels - so they kept affine as the reference model and named cross-donor validation and RNA reconstruction as the open problems. Tasks were set up as donor-held-out rotations on GSE249307 and GSE246368 with unpaired source and target cells.
dry.software: Four software deliverables. AeroEase, an Android companion app for the nebulizer, syncs ESP32-C3 button timestamps over BLE through a validated handshake with checksum, session and duplicate checks, clock calibration from the phone, and acknowledgement only after durable storage, then presents them as a locally stored medication-use diary with daily and seven-day counts, date-filtered history, CSV export, and a rule-based offline assistant that answers questions without any cloud call; the team repeatedly states the records document device actions, not delivered dose or confirmed inhalation. FeroEase, written in Flutter, monitors the two-stage fermentation over Wi-Fi with temperature, pH, stirring control and a falling-OD600 trend detector that identifies the lysis harvest window a bench fermenter does not report. The bioinformatics pipeline for club-cell target selection is the third. A browser-based quiz game supports the education activities. Hardware: AeroEase is a portable vibrating-mesh nebulizer on an ESP32-C3 with rechargeable power, session logging, BLE, a gravity-fed reservoir and physically separated liquid and electronics compartments in a modular 3D-printed housing; FeroEase is an ESP32-S3 two-stage culture platform with pH and temperature sensing, controlled heating, motor stirring and transmitted-light OD600 tracking. Build resources and a user manual with source code access are published on the wiki.

Compartmental PK-PD with Hill-function assignment rules

good.publicEngagement: Education was designed from two findings in their own clinician interviews and 461-person questionnaire: patients stop medication once they feel better, and parents refuse to start it for children out of fear of side effects, so compliance - not just awareness - became the target. Activities are segmented by audience. For children: a booth with biology-themed games at the Huairou District National Science Popularization Month fair (September 2026), doubling as a questionnaire collection point, plus a Life Science Classroom proposal for fifth and sixth graders in Huairou primary schools teaching respiratory tract structure through illustrations and interactive demos, published as a downloadable PDF so other teams can run it. For university students: an iGEM Winter Camp training new members with offline wet-lab tutorials (plasmid extraction, PCR, homologous recombination, protein purification) and online dry-lab and modelling tracks, and an annual Microbial Painting competition open to all majors as a recruitment funnel - which failed to produce the expected colony patterns, and the team published the three reasons why (cell sedimentation from static suspension, insufficient streaking density, IPTG induction of EGFP suppressing growth) and used it to teach participants that negative results are normal and troubleshooting is the skill. For the general public: a Public Science Day stall and a browser quiz game on synthetic biology and iGEM.
good.ihp: The team formalised its own cycle, RCSF (Reflect-Connect-Share-Feedback), as a deliberate parallel to the DBTL engineering cycle, and ran the project through nine documented iterations with 20 individuals, teams and institutions across six defined communities (academia, medical professionals, industry, supervisors, patients and families, the public), 44 asthma patient representatives and 419 public representatives from under-10s to over-60s. Each community is introduced with who they are, what they know, and why their position matters. The changes are specific and traceable. Doctor Fei Wang's input moved the project from rapid-acting therapy to asthma maintenance treatment, which reset the whole target population. Professor Huaiyong Chen, who studies respiratory disease mechanisms, explained that in asthma many club cells differentiate into mucus-producing goblet cells - supporting the shift away from immune cells to airway epithelium - and told them that NKX2-1, one of their two original cargoes, matters in development but has little effect in adulthood, so it was dropped and SLPI took its place. Professor Pingsheng Liu's survey of liposome, LNP and polymeric carrier limitations fed directly into the ELP carrier rationale and the protein sequence design. Professor Yufei Xia flagged subtle flaws in the experimental design and walked them through the standard in vivo/in vitro validation workflow. Yaozhong Cao, a former iGEMer, argued with them about target specificity, which is upstream of the UPK1B antibody screen. Professor Xiaoru Huang, an ethics of science and technology researcher, reviewed the biosafety and bioethics discipline. They contacted the Huairou District Bureau of Landscaping and Forestry about local pollen and catkin management, grounding the project in Beijing's own regulation (the Measures implementing the Forest Law, effective 1 January 2026) and in observed thunderstorm asthma cases. Patient work was handled with explicit informed consent and privacy statements, and the questionnaire reports its own demographics (21 recovered, 21 currently medicated, 419 unaffected). The team states its guiding principle as 'local people solving local problems', and the HP group's standing job was to track every subteam's bottlenecks and feed external input back into each one.
good.realWorld: The entrepreneurship work is a self-critical commercial assessment rather than a pitch. The team states outright that PARCEL's case must rest on defined unmet needs rather than technological novelty, and tabulates the strengths as well as the limitations of inhaled corticosteroids, bronchodilators and biologics before positioning PARCEL as a non-hormonal, lower-frequency, modular maintenance option. The SWOT names real weaknesses: delivery efficiency and duration of expression were only shown in HEK293T in vitro, so mucus, mucociliary clearance, local enzymes and immune uptake remain unaddressed; a combined protein-plus-mRNA product multiplies CMC burden across ELP molecular weight, purity, impurity profile and phase-transition behaviour and mRNA sequence integrity and stability, then payload ratio, condensate characteristics, batch consistency and storage; and the team lists the expertise it does not have (toxicology, regulatory affairs, clinical development, IP, market access). Opportunities are equally concrete - the modular Pum2/PRS-tag design means a new payload needs no new carrier, CAS institutes supply the analytical capability they lack, and China's pay-for-performance medical insurance pilot offers a reimbursement pathway for a therapy that can demonstrate efficacy. They commit to re-reviewing the SWOT at each development milestone.

gemsTakeaway: Steal the RCSF cycle: UCAS-China gave human practices the same named, repeatable four-step loop (Reflect, Connect, Share, Feedback) that engineering gets with DBTL, mapped every stakeholder into one of six communities with a stated reason for including them, and then showed nine iterations where the loop closed - including dropping a cargo gene because one researcher said it does nothing in adults. A school research centre can run that loop on any project, and the second lesson is just as cheap to copy: publish what failed, as they did with the microbial painting that never grew, and the reasons why.
